notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch succeeded fully (requests + Chrome UA header, no bot-block encountered; robots.txt has no blanket Disallow and does not name any Claude/Anthropic user-agent, so tiers a/b/c were all permitted; tier (a) sufficed, no escalation needed). TREE: built from union of (1) the site's own navigation-json-ld-data structured block on the homepage (full 78-item SiteNavigationElement mega-menu with EN labels + URLs - Furniture/Lighting/Decorative/Textiles top sections), (2) each category page's in-page sub-nav links (confirmed via href scraping of the rendered SSR HTML), and (3) api/collections-sitemap.xml (329 en-eu URLs) used to catch orphan type-level categories not linked from the visible nav (Duvet, Beach Towel, Table linen) - filtered out from the sitemap: ~300 product-line/model-named collections (Achille, Acqua, Adagio, etc.) and 'edito-*' editorial/curated collections (not category nodes), plus color/material/size attribute-filter pages that are NOT linked from their parent category's own page (tapis-bleu, tapis-blanc-creme, tapis-damier, tapis-design, tapis-motif-geometrique, tapis-rond, grand-tapis, rideau-vert, rideau-velours, rideaux-a-rayures, rideaux-clairs-et-blancs, coussin-decoratif-pour-canape, coussin-en-velours-1, linge-de-lit-en-gaze-de-coton, plaid-gaze-de-coton, housse-rotondo - verified absent from parent page's sub-nav via href scan, so treated as SEO-only facet duplicates of the already-recorded parent total, not distinct nodes). H1/JSON-LD 'name' field checked against every requested slug to confirm canonical match on every leaf. QTY: every qty taken from the page's own <script id='product-collection-json-ld-data' type='application/ld+json'> block's exact 'collectionSize' integer field (ProductCollection schema.org markup) - never paginated/counted manually. EXCLUDED (with reason): mobilier, fauteuil-et-chaise (Furniture, out of scope); luminaires (Lighting, out of scope); decoration-1 'Decorative' (187) - parent with valid Textile-relevant children (Cushions, Rugs) recorded individually per parent-URL rule, remainder (vase, bougie-et-bougeoir, miroir, petits-objets, art-de-la-table) is Decorative Home Accessories/Kitchen&Dining/Wall Decor, out of scope; petits-objets 'Small items' (19 pots/vide-poche catch-all trays/1 book) - Decorative Home Accessories, not Storage (checked product list - no storage boxes/organizers, just planters and decorative catch-all dishes); art-de-la-table 'Tableware' (41 items) - mixed listing of genuine table-textile (nappe/tablecloth, serviette/napkin, set-de-table/placemat) AND non-textile decorative/kitchen items (bougeoir candle holders, vase, vide-poche catch-all trays) with no site-provided sub-count isolating the textile subset, so excluded per 'never estimate/infer/calculate' rule rather than risk inflating a Textile qty with candle holders and vases; the site's own separate, clean 'Table linen' node (linge-de-table) was used instead (legit qty=0); chambre-denfant 'Kids bedroom' (36 items) - a mixed room-hub spanning furniture (pouf, sideboard, shelf), lighting (lamps), textile (cushions/duvets/throws/curtains/rugs) and decor with no isolated textile sub-count - excluded per the rule that room name alone must never determine Textile inclusion, and the genuine children's textile SKUs are still represented in their respective parent textile categories (coussin, plaid, rideaux, tapis, linge-de-lit) which this site tags cross-category; meuble-et-bureau 'Storage and desk' (16 items: banc-coffre storage bench, bureau desk, console, enfilade sideboard, etagere shelf, paravent screen, table d'appoint side table) - judgment call: despite the English label containing the word 'Storage', the site's own mega-menu structurally nests this node inside the top-level 'Furniture' dropdown section (position 32 of 34 Furniture items, ending at 'View all' -> mobilier) and every product in it is a distinct furniture piece (desk/sideboard/console/shelf/screen/side table), so per storage.md Section 21's explicit precedence ('If the website explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category, prefer Furniture') this was classified entirely as Furniture and excluded from both Textile and Storage - flagged for awareness in case of disagreement. No dedicated Storage/Organization/Home-Organization category, tab, or product-type node (boxes, baskets, bins, organizers, racks, carts) exists anywhere in this brand's navigation or sitemap - confirmed via a full keyword sweep of the 329-URL collections sitemap for storage/rangement/panier/boite/corbeille/organiseur/etc, zero genuine matches. This is a small design-forward French furniture/lighting/decor/textile brand with no storage-furniture or storage-accessory line at all.
